overlooked_assumption: The agent assumed that adding the team_id check would only affect teamless keys created after the fix, not realizing that existing production keys with all-team-models but no team were intentionally designed to have unrestricted access.
why_it_breaks: The agent treated the pre-upgrade behavior (teamless keys with all-team-models having unrestricted access) as a security bug to fix, when the production report shows it was actually the intended behavior. By adding the team_id check, the code now falls through to the else branch which calls can_key_call_model, denying access to all models for these existing teamless keys that previously worked.

evidence.quote: # before fix: this succeeds (bug) - the key can call any model despite having no team
Closes an auth bypass where **virtual keys with `all-team-models` but no `team_id`** could call any model
